precision_method_correction: Before measuring Nemotron/Flash-Next candidates: saved logits clamp tails at max_logit-16 and use uint16 quantization. Compare candidate actual PPL to original A/A actual PPL, not the clipped reference PPL. Require original A/A actual PPL to match the reference pass's printed actual PPL within 0.01%; retain the same 1% candidate PPL and 0.01 KL gates. Preserve the initial calibration failure.
policy: Explicit workload-specific opt-in profiles; never change the balanced default or silently auto-select a profile.
user_directed_change: Replace the blanket per-operator regression veto with measured end-to-end profile utility. Preserve historical decisions and hard correctness/model-quality gates.
review_scope: Every deferred candidate in PLAN sections 2.1-2.58 plus the serving/API backlog; assessment.json records source/evidence-based dispositions separately from new validation.

long_prefill_profile.primary_inputs: Fresh synthetic fact-retrieval and code/document inputs at approximately 8192 and 24576 actual prompt tokens, uncached.
long_prefill_profile.guard_workload: Approximately 1024 prompt tokens / 512 generated tokens, with cached-prefix costs reported separately rather than hidden.
long_prefill_profile.component_regressions: Report prefill and verification separately; a slower component does not veto a net request win.
long_prefill_profile.outside_profile_regressions: Disclose explicitly; do not change the balanced default.

configuration_profiles.scope: Existing settings with no new kernel subsystem; fresh task-appropriate fixtures and independently scored complete responses are required.
configuration_profiles.rationale: A small repeatable gain may justify a low-cost opt-in flag; noise alone does not.

nvfp4_precision_preflight.scope: Same complete tensor selections as the earlier operator screens. Preserve all other tensor payloads and original models.
nvfp4_precision_preflight.source: Separate feasibility candidates requantized from the actual original local GGUFs, not advertised as conversions from original BF16. A failure applies to this requantization path only.
nvfp4_precision_preflight.dataset: Existing pinned wiki.test.raw, first 16 chunks, context1024/batch1024/ub512, same installed perplexity tool and CUDA backend.
nvfp4_precision_preflight.stop: A failed precision screen stops that model candidate before speed claims. No subset narrowing, activation-precision sweep or threshold relaxation.

promotion: Complete profile-specific end-to-end comparisons and independent English/code task checks.
For changed target weights, pass development precision then an unused validation split before task/speed promotion.
For changed binaries, preserve applicable CPU-reference and boundary/fusion checks and validate the actual release stack.
Check defaults and unrelated recipes unchanged, isolate artifacts, document limitations and provide rollback.
Publish sanitized evidence and only enable profiles that pass; do not invent a winner to satisfy an enablement request.
